node.title: Re^3: Continuous or timed?
node.author: Bod
node.doctext:
Thank you for all the information :)

Also, my general advice for running anything from cron is always use absolute paths

Following this advice I have used the full path so my cron entry is: */2 * * * * /usr/bin/perl /home/pi/Curtains/curtains.pl If I use /usr/bin/perl /home/pi/Curtains/curtains.pl from the command line then the script runs but it doesn't run from cron. So I have enabled logging in /etc/rsyslog.conf and I get this logged: Dec 14 16:12:01 eric CRON[10129]: (pi) CMD (/usr/bin/perl /home/pi/Curtains/curtains.pl) Dec 14 16:12:01 eric CRON[10128]: (CRON) info (No MTA installed, discarding output) Dec 14 16:14:01 eric CRON[10135]: (pi) CMD (/usr/bin/perl /home/pi/Curtains/curtains.pl) Dec 14 16:14:01 eric CRON[10134]: (CRON) info (No MTA installed, discarding output) That explains why I am not getting any mail! But doesn't explain to me why the script is not running from cron. I have tried chmod 777 curtains.pl and chmod 755 curtains.pl.

What else should I be looking at to try and debug this problem>
